text:
Marta (People Ops): idea: micro-joy kit pilot for July 1 small sticker sheet + $10 e-gift. goal: low-friction, low-tax-risk recognition for folks who get quick shoutouts. need to confirm opt-in, manager approval UX, PO/GL, and customs rules. thoughts?
Owen (Logistics): sounds fun. recommend opt-in to avoid returns. regional send windows?
Marta (People Ops): regional batches: APAC wk of Jul 8, EMEA Jul 15, NAM Jul 22. managers approve 5 business days before each send.
Eve (HRBP): manager digest should be compact (name + 1-line reason). one-click approve/decline please. manager cutoff 5pm PT on Jul 10 for NAM.
Lina (Benefits): packaging mustnt show dollar amounts. e-gift email will have amount + tax FAQ link. for countries where small vouchers are taxable, benefits will flag recipients to route via payroll.
Marcus (Finance): GL suggestion GL-6160 (Employee engagement). vendor preferred via PO; net-30. if someone requests cash instead of e-gift, route through payroll (payroll cutoff Jul 12 to hit Jul 25 payroll).
Kai (Vendor Ops): vendor can fulfill e-gifts instantly and print/stuff sticker sheets for shipping. lead time: 5 business days after PO. need CSV with name/email/address + "physical_opt_in" flag.
Finn (Intern): quick headcount/opt-in est I pulled:
```
Region,Heads,OptInEstimate
APAC,130,85
EMEA,205,140
NAM,290,195
Total,625,420
```
Marta (People Ops): nice. action items: 1) Finn: finalize opt-in CSV + flag high-value cases (due Fri). 2) Marta: set up manager digest + one-click approval in the form (Mon). 3) Marcus: draft PO + confirm GL-6160 (Fri). 4) Lina: tax FAQ copy + note for e-gifts (Tue). 5) Owen: country blocklist for physical stickers (Thu). 6) Kai: confirm vendor PO template and SLA (Tue).
Owen (Logistics): customs note: small paper goods usually fine, but some countries mark all inbound mail for duty. mark as "promotional samples" and include low invoice value where allowed. Finn, can you flag prior addresses that had issues?
Finn (Intern): will cross-reference last two shipments and add a "customs_risk" column.
Lina (Benefits): also add a short one-line to manager copy: "If recipient requests cash, it must be processed via payroll (deadline Jul 12)."
Eve (HRBP): add an optional manager template to help with the 1-line praise. increases approvals.
Marcus (Finance): note contingency: add 7% overage to PO for damaged/lost items. I'll provision budget.
Kai (Vendor Ops): vendor ok with 7% buffer. PO needed by Jun 28 to hit APAC timeline.
Marta (People Ops): perfect. i'll post the nomination link and manager comms draft here when ready. ping @here when manager email goes live. any objections?
All: :thumbsup:
Marta (People Ops): thanks team 1 I'll update the tracker as items complete.
